note: Every public-facing paid or freemium app, and a classification for every domain and canonical Vercel project in canon/resources.json. Stage: prelaunch (valid config required), public (fresh passing receipt required from enforceFrom), dormant (not serving; certify before reactivating). Adding an app here makes the next pin bump scaffold it.
